## Checklist

- [ ] Linked an issue (or explained above why none exists)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change, and each new test was seen to fail once
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features` are clean
- [ ] **All commits are signed off** (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md §5](https://github.com/vyncint/lagrangian/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#5-developer-certificate-of-origin-dco)
- [ ] **No AI attribution trailers** (no AI co-authors, "Generated with" footers, or bot identities) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md §6](https://github.com/vyncint/lagrangian/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#6-ai-tooling-policy)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (user-facing changes only)
- [ ] No test threshold was loosened — or the new measurement and the reason are recorded in [PLAN.md §7](https://github.com/vyncint/lagrangian/blob/main/PLAN.md)
